message.reasoning_content:
We need to produce a rule to prevent misclassifying "单位行贿" as "行贿;受贿". The error: they predicted both bribery and receiving bribe, but correct is only "单位行贿" (i.e., the entity (company) bribed, not the individual receiving). So rule: distinguish between who is the bribe giver (unit) and who is the recipient (public official). If the fact describes a company giving money to a public official to obtain favor, charge "单位行贿" not "受贿". Keywords: "单位", "公司", "向...行贿", "给...钱", "为...谋取利益", "受贿" absent. Also "退还" indicates not receiving. So rule: when the act involves a corporate entity offering money to a public official, and the official returns the money or is not convicted, only charge unit bribery.
